investment_strategy: Barbell quality-AI strategy sized for a choppy tape. With VIX ~22 and the 10Y at 4.25% pressuring multiples, we overweight cash-generative platform leaders with durable AI monetization and moderate volatility (Microsoft, Alphabet) and keep a smaller, high-momentum semiconductor exposure (NVIDIA). Position via staggered entry (e.g., 60% of target now, 40% on further market weakness or technical confirmation) to manage near-term downside after the recent index pullback. Focus on balance-sheet strength, recurring revenue, and clear AI monetization pipelines, while capping single-name high-beta risk. Review positions on 10–15% drawdowns or if regulatory/export-control headlines change fundamentals.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility and balance-sheet strength with proven growth, positive earnings surprises, favorable analyst consensus, and clear AI monetization. Incorporated macro caution (VIX~22, 10Y 4.25%, recent tech correction) by sizing high-beta exposure smaller and concentrating in quality platforms.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Near term: cautious given valuation sensitivity to rates and ongoing regulatory/export headlines. Long term: constructive on AI—data-center capex, on-device adoption, and onshoring support multi-year growth; expect winners with scale, power access, and diversified AI revenue streams to outperform.
